headline: MiniMed completes separation from Medtronic
summary: Medtronic exchanged all of its remaining shares of the diabetes technology spinoff.

headline: MiniMed Announces Board of Directors for its Next Chapter as an Independent Company
summary: MiniMed (Nasdaq: MMED), a global leader in diabetes technology, today announced the composition of its Board of Directors following the completion of the company's separation from Medtronic. This new Board composition reflects MiniMed's priorities as an independent public company, including focused growth, continued innovation, disciplined execution and broader access to diabetes technology.
